text:
Ivy Chen: saw a quick repro in staging where the console preview panel shows another org's rows after a fast workspace swap. steps: open org-7 -> open preview -> cmd-k switch to org-9 -> preview flashes org-7 results for ~1.5s.
Carlos Ruiz: repro'd. traces show cache reads using a key with org-7 while request headers contain org-9. example log:
```
2024-05-02T11:04:10Z prefetch start id=abc headers={x-org-id: org-9}
2024-05-02T11:04:10Z cache lookup key=preview:prod:org-7:hash -> HIT
```
Nora Singh: likely race: prefetch task captures mutable req.ctx.org and workspace-change mutates it before cache lookup. affects quota attribution and dashboard telemetry.
Evan Park: quick mitigation: reject cache reads where embedded-org != req.headers['x-org-id'] and emit metric preview.org.mismatch. longer fix: capture immutable org at request start and pass explicitly to async jobs. also UI should cancel in-flight prefetches on switch.
Ivy Chen: can we add a small canary for the reject rule? if mismatch > 0.05% we should pause.
ops-bot: deploy/svc-console canary started for v2.4.3. monitoring channel: #deploy-monitoring
Carlos Ruiz: I'll open a tiny PR for org-anchored cache keys and add the metric. Nora will draft telemetry reconcile for last 48h. Evan will add UI cancel. owners: Carlos, Nora, Evan.
